# Pendexter

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Mrs.  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Pendexter is a tall, stately, and divinely beautiful woman with a highbred face. She dresses wonderfully and possesses large violet eyes framed by black lashes.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Pendexter accompanied famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on an unexpected visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During their visit, they were entertained by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a pleasant dinner and taken on a walk through the woods.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P20](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0020), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_
